headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 8, 2026**
article:
The New York Yankees edged out the Atlanta Braves 5-4 in a closely contested game, with Gerrit Cole leading the pitching effort. In other action, the Oakland Athletics secured a 7-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Tyler Soderstrom hitting a home run and driving in one run. The Miami Marlins dominated the Los Angeles Angels in a 7-0 victory, with Sandy Alcantara pitching 7.0 innings and striking out 8 batters.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Griffin Jax, who was placed on the 15-day injured list by the Tampa Bay Rays due to right elbow discomfort. Other players on the injured list include Cooper Pratt (Milwaukee Brewers), Jack Leiter (Texas Rangers), Ben Williamson (Tampa Bay Rays), Cole Wilcox (Seattle Mariners), Joe Ryan (Minnesota Twins), Slade Cecconi (Cleveland Guardians), and Chris Murphy (Chicago White Sox).

The Kansas City Royals acquired 1B Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins, while the Athletics traded for RHP Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies. The Marlins also traded RHP Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for RHP Brandan Bidois, LF Brian Sanchez, and IF Hyun Seung Lee.

top_news.title: **Braves Fall to Yankees in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees edged out the Atlanta Braves 5-4 in a closely contested game. Gerrit Cole led the Yankees' pitching effort, tossing 7.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Athletics Take Down Red Sox 7-3**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics secured a 7-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Tyler Soderstrom leading the team at the plate. Soderstrom hit a home run and drove in one run in four at-bats.

top_news.title: **Marlins Shut Out Angels 7-0**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins dominated the Los Angeles Angels in a 7-0 victory, with Sandy Alcantara leading the way on the mound. Alcantara pitched 7.0 innings, striking out 8 batters and allowing no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Phillies 7-5**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 7-5 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Nathan Lukes leading the offense. Lukes hit 3 home runs, including a key 6th homer that scored Brandon Valenzuela.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall to Nationals in One-Sided Affair**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals dominated the Cincinnati Reds 7-1, handing them a tough loss. Impact hitters for the Nationals included Abimelec Ortiz, Daylen Lile, Jorbit Vivas, and Keibert Ruiz.

top_news.title: **Athletics Edge Red Sox in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics secured a narrow win over the Boston Red Sox, taking the final score of 4-3. Impact players for the Athletics included Henry Bolte and Eli White.

top_news.title: **Rays RHP Griffin Jax Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Tampa Bay Rays right-hander Griffin Jax has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow discomfort, effective retroactive to August 6, 2026.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals' roster as part of a trade.
